# Combat text reference

The default floating-text presenter, the style asset, the per-unit publisher, and the feed and interface for building your own presenter. For how to use it, see [Combat text](../modules/combat-text.md).

## VtWorldSpaceCombatTextPresenter

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → UI → VtWorldSpaceCombatTextPresenter**.

Default combat-text presenter. Spawns TMP labels in world space above the target's head, rises them by the style's `riseDistance` over `lifetimeSec`, fades alpha linearly, and recycles them through a pool.

### Inspector fields

#### Style

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Style (`style`) | [VtCombatTextStyle](#vtcombattextstyle) | None |  | Style asset mapping VtCombatTextKind → colour / prefix / duration. Leave empty to use a sensible built-in default (white damage, yellow crits, green heals, grey dodge). |

#### Rendering

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Target Camera (`targetCamera`) | `Camera` | None |  | Camera the text billboards toward. Leave empty to use Camera.main each frame. |
| Font (`font`) | `TMP_FontAsset` | None |  | Font asset used by spawned TMP labels. Leave empty for TMP's default. |
| Render On Top (`renderOnTop`) | `bool` | On |  | When true, spawned labels render on top of all geometry — depth test is forced ZTest Always and the render queue is bumped to overlay. Use this for ARPG / RTS games where '+ 1234' must always be visible regardless of the target's mesh size or what's between camera and target. Set false for MMO-style combat text that occludes behind walls / large bodies. |
| Horizontal Jitter (`horizontalJitter`) | `float` | 0.25 | ≥ 0 | Horizontal random jitter (units) applied at spawn so overlapping hits don't stack on a single line. |
| Max Live Popups (`maxLivePopups`) | `int` | 64 | ≥ 1 | Upper bound on live popups. Older labels recycle early when this cap is hit — prevents UI swamp on heavy AoE. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `bool RenderOnTop { get; set; }` | Runtime toggle for the depth-test override. Takes effect on the next popup spawned — popups already in flight keep whatever material they were configured with. Recycled popups are re-assigned on every `Show`, so flipping this mid-session is safe. |
| `static VtWorldSpaceCombatTextPresenter Instance { get; }` | First-found live presenter in the scene. Null before Awake or after the scene unloads. For advanced scenarios multiple presenters can coexist — this accessor simply returns the most recently-enabled one. |
| `void Show(in VtCombatTextEvent evt, VtCombatTextStyle styleArg)` | Spawn a floating label for `evt` using `styleArg`, or this presenter's style when it is null. |

## VtCombatTextAutoSubscriber

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → UI → VtCombatTextAutoSubscriber**. Adds [VtUnitStats](units.md#vtunitstats), [VtUnit](units.md#vtunit) automatically.

Per-unit MonoBehaviour that translates `VtUnitStats` events into `VtCombatTextEvent`s on `VtCombatTextFeed`.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `void EnsureSubscribed()` | Idempotent wire-up of the `VtUnitStats` event handlers. Safe to call repeatedly; the first successful call latches the subscription flag. Runs on its own when the component wakes up. |

## VtCombatTextStyle

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → UI → Combat Text Style**.

ScriptableObject holding one `Entry` per `VtCombatTextKind` — colour, prefix, suffix, font scale, rise distance, lifetime, optional audio clip. Create one with *Create → Vantage → UI → Combat Text Style*, tune the entries and assign it to the presenter.

### Inspector fields

#### Base

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Base Font Size (`baseFontSize`) | `float` | 6 | ≥ 1 | Default font size for all entries (multiplied by entry.fontScale). |
| Head Offset Y (`headOffsetY`) | `float` | 2 |  | World-space vertical offset from the target's transform.position. Adjust so text spawns near the unit's head. |

#### Entries

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Entries (`entries`) | [VtCombatTextStyle.Entry](#vtcombattextstyleentry)[] | Empty |  | Per-kind overrides. First matching entry for a kind wins. |

#### Fallback

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Defaults (`defaults`) | [VtCombatTextStyle.Entry](#vtcombattextstyleentry) | — |  | Used when a kind has no matching entry. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `VtCombatTextStyle.Entry GetEntry(VtCombatTextKind kind)` | Look up the entry for `kind`. First match wins; no match returns `defaults`. |
| `static VtCombatTextStyle CreateBuiltIn()` | Populate `entries` with a sensible built-in style (white damage, yellow crits, green heals, grey dodge / resist, blue absorb). Used by the default presenter when no style asset is assigned so it works out-of-the-box with zero authoring. |

## IVtCombatTextPresenter

Interface. Implemented by [VtWorldSpaceCombatTextPresenter](#vtworldspacecombattextpresenter).

Rendering seam for combat-text events. Default implementation is `VtWorldSpaceCombatTextPresenter` (pooled TMP labels in world space). Swap for a custom presenter — UI-Toolkit overlay, particle-driven, screen-space toast — by disabling the default and subscribing your own implementation to `VtCombatTextFeed.OnEvent`.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `void Show(in VtCombatTextEvent evt, VtCombatTextStyle style)` | Render the given event. Implementations must not throw and must cope with `style` being the fallback default. |

## VtCombatTextEvent

Struct.

Payload pushed through `VtCombatTextFeed` whenever something happens on a unit that floating-text UI wants to surface. Struct — no allocation per hit.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `readonly VtCombatTextKind kind` | Which kind of event this is. Styles key off this. |
| `readonly int amount` | Magnitude to display. For `VtCombatTextKind.Damage` / `VtCombatTextKind.Heal` / their crit/tick variants this is the final applied value. For `VtCombatTextKind.Absorb` this is the amount absorbed. Zero for `VtCombatTextKind.Dodge` / `VtCombatTextKind.Immune` / `VtCombatTextKind.Resist` (the style's text label is what shows). |
| `readonly VtDamageType damageType` | Element of the hit. Presenters can tint damage numbers per-element (fire = orange, cold = cyan) on top of the style's base colour. |
| `readonly bool isCrit` | True if the underlying hit crit. Already reflected in `kind` (Crit / CritHeal / DotTickCrit / HealTickCrit) but exposed as a separate flag so presenters that ignore kind can still detect crits quickly. |
| `readonly VtUnitId attacker` | Attacker / healer. Resolve via `VtUnitRegistry.Resolve` if a live reference is needed. `VtUnitId.None` for environmental. |
| `readonly VtUnit target` | The unit the text floats above. Presenters anchor the text's world-space position to this transform. |
| `readonly Vector3 worldPosition` | World-space spawn point. By default the target's head position (target.transform.position + a small vertical offset) but publishers may override (e.g. impact point on the model). |

## VtCombatTextFeed

Static class.

Lightweight global pub/sub for `VtCombatTextEvent`s. Damage / heal / evade sites call `Publish`; one or more presenters subscribe to `OnEvent` and render the text.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static event Action<VtCombatTextEvent> OnEvent` | Fires whenever a combat-text-worthy event happens on any unit. Subscribers are responsible for filtering (e.g. by target faction, local-player focus) if they don't want every unit's chatter. |
| `static void Publish(in VtCombatTextEvent evt)` | Publish an event. Safe to call with no subscribers — no-op. Called from inside damage / heal / evade paths; must be cheap (no allocations beyond the struct on the stack). |
| `static void Clear()` | Remove every subscriber. Runs on its own when play mode starts. |

## VtCombatTextStyle.Entry

Serializable struct.

Per-kind visual configuration. Missing / null entries fall back to `defaults`.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kind (`kind`) | [VtCombatTextKind](#vtcombattextkind) | `Damage` |  | Which event kind this entry applies to. |
| Color (`color`) | `Color` | `#00000000` |  | Text colour. The label fades out from this colour over its lifetime. |
| Prefix (`prefix`) | `string` | Empty |  | Text before the number (e.g. '+' for heals, 'DODGE' for dodges). For Dodge / Immune / Resist the prefix usually IS the whole label and amount is 0. |
| Suffix (`suffix`) | `string` | Empty |  | Text after the number (e.g. '!' for crits). |
| Font Scale (`fontScale`) | `float` | 0 | ≥ 0.1 | Multiplier on the style's base font size. Crits usually 1.5–2.0; ticks 0.75. |
| Rise Distance (`riseDistance`) | `float` | 0 | ≥ 0 | World-space upward drift over the text's lifetime (units). |
| Lifetime Sec (`lifetimeSec`) | `float` | 0 | ≥ 0.05 | Seconds before the text fades out and is recycled. |
| Sound (`sound`) | `AudioClip` | None |  | Optional SFX played when this kind fires. Audio source is the presenter's own AudioSource (2D by default). |

## Enums

### VtCombatTextKind

Classification of a floating-text event. Used by `VtCombatTextStyle` to look up per-kind visual settings (colour, prefix, font scale) and by `VtCombatTextEvent` as the payload's tag.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Damage` | Direct damage. Fires for any `VtUnitStats.OnPostTakeDamage` where `appliedDamage > 0`, `!wasCrit`, and not a tick. |
| `Crit` | Critical direct damage — `appliedDamage > 0 && wasCrit`. |
| `DotTick` | Damage-over-time tick landing (non-crit). DoT crits map to `DotTickCrit`. |
| `DotTickCrit` | Critical DoT tick (tick + `wasCrit`). |
| `Heal` | Non-crit heal applied via `VtUnitStats.Heal`. |
| `CritHeal` | Critical heal. |
| `HealTick` | Heal-over-time tick (non-crit). |
| `HealTickCrit` | Critical heal-over-time tick. |
| `Dodge` | Evaded (dodged) hit — `VtUnitStats.OnEvaded`. |
| `Absorb` | Hit absorbed in full by a shield — pipeline reached the rounding step with `appliedDamage == 0` but `absorbed > 0`. |
| `Immune` | Pre-hook cancelled the hit (block / immunity / phase-out). |
| `Resist` | Non-evaded, non-cancelled hit with `appliedDamage == 0` — usually means element resistance + matrix reduced it to nothing. |

### VtDamageType

The *element* of an attack — routed through the corresponding `resistX` stat on `VtCoreStats` in `VtUnitStats.TakeDamage`.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Physical` | Weapons, claws and falling rocks. Reduced by armor; resisted by stat.resist_physical. |
| `Fire` | Fire and burning. Resisted by stat.resist_fire. |
| `Cold` | Frost and ice. Resisted by stat.resist_cold. |
| `Poison` | Poison and venom, often dealt over time. Resisted by stat.resist_poison. |
| `True` | Bypasses all mitigation (resistance, armor, matrix). Use sparingly. |
| `Lightning` | Electricity / chain-lightning / EMP-flavor. Resisted by stat.resist_lightning. |
| `Holy` | Paladin / priest school. Strong vs undead in many genres. Resisted by stat.resist_holy. |
| `Shadow` | Warlock / necromancer school — corruption, agony, void. Resisted by stat.resist_shadow. Often paired oppositionally with Holy. |
| `Arcane` | Mage's "raw magic" school — distinct from elemental. Magic missile, polymorph. Resisted by stat.resist_arcane. Conventionally hardest to resist. |
| `Nature` | Druid / shaman school — earth, plant, weather, wildlife. Resisted by stat.resist_nature. |
